what_happened: Task description asserts the model-level pumping lemma for tpOf is absent and uncosted. Codebase audit found the SPLICE/PUMP half fully landed before task creation: LadderPump.lean tpOf_eq_spliceIdx_of_tpOf_eq (duplication type lemma), LadderChain.lean exists_typeBlock_of_spacing (spaced type pigeonhole), realized_typeBlock_mem_prodCycleLens and typeBlock_length_dvd_of_paramsOk (bridge), plus both iterated-duplication assemblies. What is genuinely absent is a PERIODICITY statement about tpOf along a ladder path (threshold+period, the model-side analogue of prodPre_periodic's satThreshold/satPeriod). Plan narrowed to that object: a conditional periodicity lemma under a globally periodic object walk, plus a compiled refutation of the unconditional eventual-periodicity form.

The positive lemma reduces to three landed facts with no new machinery: WorldHistory.timeShift_state (PartialHistory.lean:566), tpOf_timeShift (AnchorLayer.lean:122) and half (i) tpOf_stabFree_eq_of_objAt_eq (LadderAgree.lean:2298). Phase 1 is therefore a ~15-line proof rather than an induction over the closure, and the refuted splice shape is avoided structurally (one path, two positions, no surgery) rather than by a side condition.

Phase 1 commit refused by typst-sync-check.sh Check 2: typst/generated/status.typ's formalsystem-line-count was stale by exactly 65 lines, the size of this phase's LadderAgree.lean insertion. Drift is wholly attributable to this task (delta matches the insertion exactly), so the sanctioned --fix remedy was run and typst/generated/status.typ added to the phase commit as a scope extension.

Phase 2 plan bullet asserted the probe's witness violates tpOf_periodic_of_objAt_periodic's hypothesis 'at every l'. False at l = 0, where global 0-periodicity holds of every walk. The probe-internal lemma was landed as wA_not_periodic (l : Z) (hl : l != 0) and the docstring states the l = 0 case explicitly. No Challenge-pinned hypothesis or conclusion changed; this corrects an overstatement in plan prose, not a decomposition deviation.

Phase 1's planned proof (tpOf_timeShift composed with half (i) at sigma.timeShift l) compiled on the first attempt with no tactic search, and the all-idle two-state fixture for Phase 2's probe discharged four of exists_ladderPath_of_walk's six side conditions vacuously. The plan's choice of fixture saved the usual Count/Drift fixture work.

Phase 4 plan-marker edit used a bare substring anchor ('## Lean Challenge Statements') as the end of the Phase 4 slice. That string also occurs inline in Phase 1's prose at an EARLIER offset, so end < start and the splice duplicated Phases 2-3 into the plan. Detected immediately by a post-edit heading grep showing duplicate Phase 2/3 headings; recovered with 'git show HEAD:<path> > <path>' (no destructive git) and redone with line-indexed, forward-searched heading anchors. This is the exact failure mode lean-implementation-flow Stage 4A's section-anchoring rule warns about.
